steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Republic was a mixed constitution with monarchical (consuls), aristocratic (Senate) and democratic (assemblies) elements

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Two consuls were elected annually with imperium (power of command); they could veto each other (intercessio)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Senate was the most powerful body: 300 patrician elders who controlled foreign policy, finances and state religion

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The comitia centuriata (centuriate assembly) elected consuls and declared war; voting was weighted by wealth

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Mixed constitution: monarchy (consuls) + aristocracy (Senate) + democracy (assemblies) Senate = most powerful long-term; Consuls = executive; Tribunes = plebeian protection Veto power was the key check: consuls veto each other, tribunes veto anyone Dictator = 6-month emergency power, then must resign
